properties.geometry_quality: approximate (route through geocoded forts; not traced)
properties.note: Begun in AD 122 and largely finished within about six years. Survives unevenly: best in the central hilly sector, little in the lowlands where stone was reused. Route shown is approximate; the documented length is 117 km.
